mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression through different pathways; carisoprodol metabolizes to meprobamate (CNS depressant) and hydrocodone is an opioid agonist, resulting in additive respiratory and neurological depression.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only if absolutely necessary with careful monitoring; counsel patients on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants, and monitor for respiratory depression, excessive sedation, and impaired cognition.
